in_marathi.name: Surj
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Sun, Brave, Strong
in_marathi.long_meaning: Surj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Surj is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Surya', which means 'Sun'. The name is also associated with the qualities of bravery and strength. In Hindu mythology, Surj is the name of the Sun God, who is revered for his power and energy. The name Surj is considered to be auspicious and is often given to baby boys in Hindu families.
